title: Stit Semantics for Epistemic Notions Based on Information Disclosure in Interactive Settings
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical work in modal logic (specifically stit, epistemic, and deontic logic) aimed at formalizing notions of responsibility, culpability, and knowledge in AI agents. While it deals with epistemology and moral concepts like blame and responsibility, it is a formal mathematical proposal and proof of a logical system rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of these concepts, and it does not involve Large Language Models or NLP systems.
